=== Response to Applicants Objections_59745_807_Exhibit 1.pdf ===
      ONCOR and LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765 kV Transmission Project
                          SOAH Docket 473-26-16349
                            PUC TX Docket #59475

RESPONSE TO ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA
TRANSMISSION SERVICE CORPORATION OBJECTIONS IN PUCT FILING #5936 TO
EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

Intervenors M Rex and Kelli A Emerson respectfully urge the Court to deny Applicant’s
objection to Exhibit 1, # 807.

   1. It is our understanding that in the June 5, 2026 hearing, applicants did not object to any of
      the exhibits pre-filed on the Court’s SOAH Order 30 exhibit A, subject to the opportunity
      to object to the late-filed exhibits not previously included in Exhibit A or not filed in the
      Egnyte portal. Exhibit 1, #807 was timely filed in all three portals and was included in the
      Court’s Order; therefore, Applicant’s objection is untimely.
   2. Applicant filed her objections after the Court ordered time limit of June 7, 2026, 12 noon;
      therefore, her objections are untimely.
   3. The primary difference between intervenor’s original filing and Exhibit 1 is a party
      introduction and the addition of a jurat that was inadvertently left off the previously filed
      Position and Testimony document. There are no substantive additions to the testimony,
      and no surprises.

   For the above-stated reasons, the Intervenor respectfully urges the Court to deny Applicant’s
   objection to Exhibit 1, #807 and allow Intervenor’s testimony to stand as previously
   admitted.

   Respectfully submitted,

   M Rex Emerson
